It's time to make a next step. **React-Hot-Loader is expected to be replaced by [React Fast Refresh](https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/16604)**. Please remove React-Hot-Loader if Fast Refresh is currently supported on your environment. * `React Native` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://facebook.github.io/react-native/docs/fast-refresh) since 0.61. * `parcel 2` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/16604#issuecomment-556082893) since alpha 3. * `webpack` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://github.com/pmmmwh/react-refresh-webpack-plugin/) using a plugin. * `other bundler` - no support yet, use React-Hot-Loader * `create-react-app` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://create-react-app.dev/docs/advanced-configuration/) with FAST_REFRESH env since 4. * `next.js` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://nextjs.org/docs/basic-features/fast-refresh) since 9.4 #

Please remove React-Hot-Loader if Fast Refresh is currently supported on your environment. * `React Native` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://facebook.github.io/react-native/docs/fast-refresh) since 0.61. * `parcel 2` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/16604#issuecomment-556082893) since alpha 3. * `webpack` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://github.com/pmmmwh/react-refresh-webpack-plugin/) using a plugin. * `other bundler` - no support yet, use React-Hot-Loader * `create-react-app` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://create-react-app.dev/docs/advanced-configuration/) with FAST_REFRESH env since 4. * `next.js` - [supports Fast Refresh](https://nextjs.org/docs/basic-features/fast-refresh) since 9.4 #
